title: Driver app: ordered stops, passengers per stop, boarded / no-show ticks, head count, documents checked, tour leader role, offline ticks
goal: A tour leader (or a driver allowed to) opens today's coach trip on the phone, sees the stops in order with times, ticks each passenger boarded or no-show, marks documents checked, sees the head count, and completes each stop, also without signal.
why: Gap 4 on the phone: the app today shows one trip per leg with passengers in the notes. Design: TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 5.3 and 11; API from R145.

edit: packages/shared/lib/models/** (trip stop and passenger models only)

steps: packages/shared: TripStop and TripPassenger models (freezed + json, nullable-safe), endpoints for stops arrive/depart, passengers PUT, headcount; regenerate code with build_runner through x86 PowerShell.
trip_repository.dart: fetch trip with stops and passengers (passengers absent when the server does not send them), arrive/depart, tick, headcount; profile_repository reads crew_role.
Trip card: for coach trips 'N stops, M passengers' and the next stop with its time; tour-leader trips show a crew badge.
Trip detail: stop_timeline (time, name, documents-check badge, status) with Arrived / Depart actions and navigate / call buttons (existing helpers).

stop_screen: passengers boarding here with passenger_tile (Boarded / No-show toggle, Documents checked toggle shown when the stop has documents_check and from the menu elsewhere), headcount_bar (boarded / expected at this stop and overall), 'Complete stop'. Shown to tour leaders, and to drivers when the server sends passengers.
Keys for integration tests: stop-card-{id}, passenger-{id}-boarded, passenger-{id}-no-show, passenger-{id}-documents, headcount, complete-stop.
All text through the ARB files in en, hi, ar and nl (hi and ar may copy English where no translation is available, as the app does today).

checkin_queue.dart: a tick updates the screen at once, is stored in Hive with an opId (uuid) and 'at' timestamp, and is sent in order when online; failures retry with backoff; a server 409/404 drops the op and refreshes the trip. The trip cache keeps the last stops and passengers for offline viewing.

tests: coach_stops_test.dart: timeline order and statuses; stop screen ticks update the head count; documents toggle visible on a documents-check stop; a driver without passengers sees stops only; nl locale renders.
checkin_queue_test.dart: ticks queued offline are sent in order with their opIds once online; a replayed op is harmless; a 404 drops the op.
trip_stop_model_test.dart: JSON parsing with and without passengers.
Existing driver app and shared tests stay green.
acceptance: A tour leader can run a seven-stop pickup with ticks and head count on the emulator against the local stack.
Ticks made without signal reach the office once the phone is back online.
gate: tasklist | findstr /i "java.exe dart.exe flutter"   # must show no Gradle/Flutter build in progress (the owner may be building)

x86 PowerShell: "C:/Windows/SysWOW64/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe" -Command "cd C:/Users/Admin/Downloads/pro/CRM/packages/shared; dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs; flutter analyze; flutter test; cd ../driver_app; flutter gen-l10n; flutter analyze; flutter test"
productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere (tests use invented stops).
Flutter only through x86 PowerShell; never run Flutter from bash.
Feature switch: the server decides (403 or absent fields); the app hides what the server does not send.
Phones and money through the shared helpers with the agency country and currency (R136).
Never weaken, skip or delete an existing test.
notes: Before editing read: this file, TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 5.3, 6.3 and 11, R145's driver routes, packages/driver_app/test/trip_cache_test.dart and trip_actions_test.dart for patterns.
An emulator run is optional for the gate (unit and widget tests are the gate); scripts/record-driver.ps1 integration flows are not part of this batch.
goLiveVerify: The release APK with the new screens on a real phone against staging.
